caseName: Hartman v. John D. Park & Sons Co.
caseNameFull: Samuel B. Hartman v. John D. Park & Sons Company

opinions.text: On writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit. December 21, 1908. Dismissed with costs, on motion of counsel for the petitioner. Mr. Frank F. Reed for petitioner. Mr. Wm. J. Shroder and Mr, Alton B. Parker for respondent.
